answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence must be continually renewed through sustained, reciprocated honest service; old endorsements cannot grant permanent authority. EigenTrust-style centrality is derived from normalized trust links and reciprocity-weighted transitivity, leaving freshly spawned Sybil identities with near-zero eigenvector centrality and insufficient consensus weight. Names such as meadow, walnut, and quartz confer no trust by themselves.
